# FinalYearKit

> Submission-ready final year project kits for B.Tech, BCA, BBA, and MCA students in India.
> Working code + 8-chapter report + presentation deck + viva question bank, customized to the student's college.

Website: https://finalyearkit.com
Contact: contact@finalyearkit.com
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/917420879220

## What we sell

Complete college / final-year project kits (not generic GitHub dumps). Every Complete kit typically includes:

- Full working source code with setup instructions
- 8-chapter academic Word report
- ~14-slide presentation deck
- Viva Q&A bank matched to that exact codebase
- Name / college / department customization

Pricing tiers (INR, same across kits): Starter ~₹1,499 (code), Standard ~₹2,499 (code + report + slides), Complete ~₹3,499 (adds viva bank + customization + WhatsApp support until submission).

Payment is arranged over WhatsApp (UPI). Ask for a live demo before paying.

## Blog (guides for students)

Architecture, viva prep, and project-picking posts live at https://finalyearkit.com/blog — including RAG explainers, viva question banks, AI vs MERN choice guides, and kit-specific defense notes.

## Audience & tone

Speak to Indian final-year students who need a defensible submission package. Prefer plain English. Kits are learning/reference resources — students remain responsible for their institution's academic integrity policy.
